title: Immaculate Constellation hub at Schriever Air Force Base
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Immaculate Constellation hub at Schriever Air Force Base, about c. 2018 at Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: towards uh Shrivever Air Force Base in Colorado as being at least one hub of of this program.

plain: Matthew Brown, a man who calls himself a Pentagon whistleblower, told podcast host Jesse Michels about "Immaculate Constellation," his name for a secret government programme that he says gathers data on UAP, the government's newer term for UFOs. Brown says a briefing on the programme's capabilities, from around 2018, pointed to Schriever Air Force Base in Colorado as at least one hub of the programme. If true, it would place a hidden UFO effort at a specific military base.
